sources.title: Government of the Republic of Kosovo: Decision No. 14/280
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government's official kryeministri.rks-gov.net domain hosts the signed 19 December 2025 decision that amends the Fiji visa-regime annex and expressly conditions effect on Official Gazette publication.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Vendimi hyn në fuqi ditën e publikimit në Gazetën Zyrtare të Republikës së Kosovës.

sources.title: Embassies of the Republic of Kosovo: Kosovo Visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Diaspora of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The live ambasadat.net page identifies the Kosovo Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Diaspora and publishes its short-stay visa-exempt country list; its list directly includes Fiji (Fixhi).

sources.title: Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.publisher: Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official Gazette register provides searchable legal-act records. Its current site search was checked for Fiji/Fixhi and Decision 14/280; no publication record or later controlling Fiji visa act was retrieved. This unsuccessful search is not treated as proof of nonpublication.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës

conflicts.officialStatus: unresolved: live MFA visa-free list conflicts with signed visa-regime amendment whose Gazette effect is unverified
conflicts.explanation: Kosovo's live MFA list names Fiji as visa-free, but signed Decision No. 14/280 introduces a Fiji visa regime only on Official Gazette publication. The current Gazette search did not retrieve that publication or a later controlling act, so neither outcome can be selected as operative.

unresolved.reason: The live Kosovo MFA short-stay list directly names Fiji (Fixhi) as visa-exempt, while signed Decision No. 14/280 introduces a Fiji visa regime but makes its effect conditional on Official Gazette publication. No Gazette publication record or later controlling official act was retrieved in the current review. A signed but conditional decision is not normalized, and the contradictory live list cannot safely control without a legal-currentness basis.
